summary_md: **Jagrit Chawla ([@jagu_builds](https://x.com/jagu_builds/status/2115811252358492382))** points to prompt packs, notably a collection of 475 prompts for videos, 3D scenes and browser games made with Claude, each linked to its demo, arguing for reusable prompt libraries ([yihui-dev/awesome-opus5-5-videos](https://github.com/yihui-dev/awesome-opus5-5-videos)).
